topic: Air store Establishment (ASE): Introduction, Definition, Purpose and Characteristics

specific_objectives: 5.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain air stores terminologies, ASE, Demands and Survey of IN aviation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of IN Aviation Air Store Survey Data; Safety: Handle documents carefully; Supervision: Instructor monitors data interpretation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an Air Store Establishment?
Can you list three key characteristics of an Air Store Establishment?
Why is the Survey of IN aviation important for ASE?

development.content:
Introduction to Air Store Establishment
Definition of ASE
Purpose of ASE
Characteristics of ASE
Role in IN Aviation

Terminologies in Air Stores

Future Trends in ASE

summary_questions: Explain the difference between the purpose and characteristics of an Air Store Establishment.
How does the Survey of IN aviation support the ASE?
